extraction.Name: Alice Cunningham (now Deer With Horns)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded on July 12, 1920 by the Citizens State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Alice Deer With Horns, formerly Alice Cunningham, and Robert Deer With Horns conveyed the land to Anon B. Hord for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739632 issued; southeast quarter of section 24, township 43, range 26; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; deed executed June 19, 1920; located at Rosebud, S. Dak.
